ionization_model: vanOverstraeten local InAlAs, literature a,b baseline
rule: Scale both electron/hole exponential field parameters by the same factor, estimated from field needed at 24 V divided by raw ionization threshold field. This calibrates the model, not output current. PT breakdown and all optical responsivities are unfit validation targets.
after_band_alignment: Common b_scale=1.182 retained without extra fit; final breakdown must be validated in recomputed native IV.
